ov: The common nightingale, a plain brown bird with a reddish tail, famous for one of the most beautiful songs in nature. Only males sing, often at night as well as by day. It breeds in forest and scrub from Europe to Mongolia and winters in Africa.
rg: Breeds in Europe, North Africa and western and central Asia; winters in sub-Saharan Africa.
fx: Unpaired males can sing through the night for 7 to 8 hours to attract a mate.
Its name means "night songstress", though it is the male that sings.
